pages.title: As You Wish
pages.text: Golden Dandelion · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Golden Dandelion Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)He who polishes the lamp is granted one wish.$(br2)— One Thousand and One Nights

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: Grants one random level-II boon, or luck.$(br2)$(br2)Wish Granted instant
